name: narration
description: Scripts written to be spoken: audio essays, video voiceover, podcast segments.
register: spoken, direct address, built for the ear
notes: `medium: audio` activates `prose-medium-critic` in the prose-review bundle, which checks
homograph traps (close/live/read/content/refuse), numerals and dates that
TTS engines mis-verbalise, unglossed foreign terms, and breath length.
None of that is in the deterministic pass.
Fragments are a legitimate device here, not a tic — spoken prose uses them
for emphasis constantly — so fragment_rate is not banded in this register.
